source_evidence: read every statement promptly -- it may not be fun to look at it when the market is down, but it is your most important protection against unauthorized transactions.
answer: Review each brokerage or advisory account statement promptly, even when market conditions make it uncomfortable to look. Statements can help you spot unauthorized transactions. If something is wrong, object right away; waiting after you receive notice of a transaction might mean you can no longer contest it. Objecting in writing can better protect your rights.
